gaps.term: Bounded scan cost of digit and field moves
gaps.quote: Moving a single digit in a fixed radix takes a bounded number of scans, but moving whole fields with growing numbers of digits needs more work.
gaps.note: The page asserts cost bounds for moving digits and fields without defining the cost measure, the machine model, or giving any argument, so the reader cannot check the claim.
